title: Close-area benchmark matrix: 9 planners x 8 arena families x 2 range-sensor presets, with replays in the world JSON format
summary: Runs every close-area planner in the hub through the shared close-area-arena on the same seeded layouts and scores them on truth: straight, freest_beam, APF with wall-follow escape, VFH+, A* + ESDF on the known map, A* + ESDF on a map built from range hits (with the area geofence as its map prior), Informed RRT* 5000 on the known map, A* with the corridor MPC follower, and the unknown-map A* behind the F2 PX4-CBF safety filter. Families: random, u_trap, narrow_gap, office, warehouse, forest, maze, glass_office. Presets: ideal 72-ray fan and a Crazyflie Multi-ranger preset (4 cone beams, 3 m, glass invisible). 20 layouts per cell, seed 0, 14 worker processes, 120 s limit on maze and warehouse. Writes one reached / collision table per preset with the best planner per family, and export_replays.py writes one replay per family x planner (layout 0) embedding the close-area-world/1 document, truth path, clearance per step and outcome, checked against the matrix rows. Planners are imported by path from their samples, unedited. Synthetic arena only.
verified: ran 2026-11-09 with CPython 3.12.10 + numpy 2.5.4 / scipy 1.18.1 / osqp 1.1.3 on an Apple M3 Max (16 cores, macOS arm64), in the sample venv: bench.py --layouts 20 --seed 0 --workers 14 --parity ran once, 2,880 flights, wall 323.4 s, parity with run.evaluate 10/10 for straight and astar_known; bench.py prior-check run (shipped vs geofenced unknown-map A*, ideal, office / warehouse / glass_office) wall 28.6 s; export_replays.py wrote 72 replays (max 22,673 bytes), 72/72 outcomes and min clearances match results/matrix_0.json, 72/72 world JSON round trips. Every number in README is from results/. test_smoke.py: 1 passed in the venv, 1 skipped under plain python3 without numpy. The matrix was run once, not repeated for determinism (the replay re-runs of layout 0 match it). Layouts, vehicle and sensors are simulated; planner sees the true pose; no SITL, no real drone. The showcase and playground pages were not checked against replays_v2.
shows: Which close-area planner reaches B in which room type (clutter, U trap, gap, office, warehouse, forest, maze, glass office) with a 72-ray sensor and with a 4-beam Crazyflie-like sensor, plus a replay per room type and planner
runtime: ~5.5 min for the 2,880-flight matrix on 14 processes, ~1 min for the 72 replays
key_result: [20 layouts per cell, seed 0](README.md#results-ran-2026-11-09-synthetic): prior-map planners (A* known, Informed RRT*, A* + MPC) 100 % reached, 0 % collision in all 8 families on both presets; unknown-map A* 95 % on office with 72 rays but 35 % with 4 Crazyflie beams, 0 % on warehouse (50 % collision) and 5 % on glass_office (65 % collision) 14 planners incl. DWA, Bug2, TangentBug and D* Lite (unknown map 85-100 % reached on ideal, 0 % collisions).
